purpose: Teach: アワ/ニャン/童貞/メヒコ/ペセタ/ルーシー/レヴィナス/スラブ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「四国徳島のアワ、つまり粟料理を一緒に食べよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying he wants to eat awa together — you know, that millet dish from Tokushima.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. Soft attention on Sho's name. Light, almost amused warmth when relaying her father-in-law's invitation. No urgency, just passing along something sweet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとペットの猫に「ニャン」って真似して鳴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I made cat sounds with Dad — I did the 'nyan' thing with him and even petted the cat.
lines.style: Quick, bright energy. Pride in the small accomplishment. Eager to share — like he's been holding this moment and finally gets to tell her. Childlike directness, no shyness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「童貞時代に書いた詩を読んでみない?」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was mentioning he'd like to show you some poems he wrote when he was younger.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a touch more reserved. Soft respect in the voice — she's passing along something personal. Slight pause before the intimacy of it, like she's gauging if he'll want to hear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとメキシコ、つまりメヒコの絵本を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Mexico together today.
lines.style: Steady, simple happiness. Not as explosive as before — this is a quieter kind of proud. Like he's grown comfortable enough to share without needing to prove it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「旧スペイン通貨のペセタを見せてあげる」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying he wants to show you some old Spanish peseta coins he has.
lines.style: Warm and unhurried. A gentle enthusiasm — like she's delighted by her father-in-law's thoughtfulness. Speaking with care, like these small offerings matter because they do.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとピーナッツのルーシーの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a Peanuts book with Lucy in it. That was fun.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost settling into contentment. Still eager but less frantic. The 'that was fun' lands with genuine simplicity — he's learned to just be with the moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「レヴィナス哲学は他者を大切にする教え」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was teaching me that Levinas's philosophy is really about cherishing others and their needs.
lines.style: Reflective, almost philosophical herself. Slower pace. Reverence for the idea and what her father-in-law was sharing. Speaking as if she's still turning it over in her mind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとスラブ系民族の民謡聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I listened to some Slavic folk songs together. It was really nice.
lines.style: Gentle closure. Softer than his earlier energy but no less genuine. Like he's found a quieter way to tell her these things matter. The contentment is deeper now.
